title: Bind EXP019 compatibility fixtures and rerun the fixed 2026-08-08 Grade-R card

proposal_scope.title: Bind EXP019 compatibility fixtures and rerun the fixed 2026-08-08 Grade-R card
proposal_scope.hypothesis: The EXP020 implementation is sufficient for the unchanged fixed Grade-R card, and explicitly committing and hash-binding the three immutable EXP019 target-manifest compatibility fixtures is sufficient for the exact 92-test command and the unchanged real card command to complete.
proposal_scope.null_hypothesis: The compatibility fixtures do not exactly match their archived bytes; the fixed test command or real card command still fails; or any code, model, feature, threshold, candidate, market, or production change is required.
proposal_scope.racing_mechanism: The frozen model requires each runner's latest historical performance context. DI260808 contains those pre-race observations inside each horse block, but the multicard adapter currently retains only the current runner identity and discards the history table. This experiment restores existing model inputs without changing their definitions or the model policy.
proposal_scope.target_population: All 36 fixed races and 462 runners from the 2026-08-08 Sapporo, Niigata, and Chukyo cards. Every race remains in the denominator; races whose original cutoff has expired and the unsupported Chukyo obstacle race remain deterministic no-bet.
in_scope: After a distinct APPROVED_TO_RUN grant, execute the unchanged fixed-card shadow command once and retain all late or unsupported races as terminal no-bet rows
Commit the three archived EXP019 target manifests as immutable backward-compatibility fixtures and bind their exact SHA-256 values in the run scope

Create an EXP021 successor config and fixed target manifests by changing experiment and cohort identity only; preserve all model, feature, calibrator, candidate, confidence, value, tie-break, and safety settings from EXP020
Keep all 36 race identities, 462 runners, history sources, model artifacts, and source-time contracts fixed
Keep formal_buy false, send_order false, stake zero, dashboard mutation false, notification false, credential access false, and order imports disabled
Run the same pre-registered 92-test command, including the EXP019 compatibility test, without modifying test or implementation code

proposal_scope.data_as_of: EXP020 became INVALID at 2026-08-08T14:38:43+09:00 when the first exact command passed 91 of 92 tests and failed only because three immutable EXP019 target-manifest compatibility fixtures were absent from the execution worktree. The real DI command was not started, and no candidate, quote, result, ROI, BUY, order, notification, or stake side effect occurred.

chronological_fold_design.candidate_clock: feature source time <= generation start <= generation completion <= freeze commit <= persist acknowledgement < original candidate cutoff.
chronological_fold_design.design: One fixed real-time Grade-R engineering card after synthetic-only parser preparation and a distinct run approval; there is no fitting, fold selection, backtest, ROI, or model comparison.
chronological_fold_design.history_clock: Only the newest DI history row with normalized source date strictly less than 2026-08-08 may populate previous-race features.
chronological_fold_design.late_race_rule: A race whose original cutoff has passed before persistence is retained as deterministic no-bet and is never backfilled.
chronological_fold_design.quote_clock: Frozen candidate first; then exact-pair quote handling under the unchanged strict contract.
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: No real DI parsing output, inference, quote, result, payout, or ROI operation is allowed during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE. Synthetic fixtures only.

purge_embargo.history_cutoff: No row dated 2026-08-08 or later may enter target features.
purge_embargo.market_firewall: No odds, popularity, market rank, payout, ROI, or derivative may influence candidate selection, confidence, tie-break, or abstention.
purge_embargo.post_event_embargo: No missed candidate cutoff or strict quote cutoff may be repaired with later information.
purge_embargo.target_selection_embargo: All 36 race identities and 462 runners remain fixed independently of market and results.

primary_metric.baseline: EXP020 passed 91 of 92 exact tests; the only failure was a missing immutable EXP019 compatibility manifest before the real DI command started.
primary_metric.evaluation: All 92 exact tests pass with the three fixtures hash-bound; then all 24 prior-race columns exist for 462 rows, 420 experienced runners map one pre-target row, 42 no-history runners are explicit, and all 36 targets terminate deterministically.
primary_metric.name: previous_race_schema_and_candidate_terminal_completeness

notes: Successor to EXP020; fixture-only execution-material closure, no prediction-policy change.
